question: Should OpenClaw accept object-form `plugins.slots.*` owner records as a persisted config and plugin-author contract now, or keep slot values string-only until the broader slot architecture is decided?
rationale: The code change is a compatibility-sensitive config/API expansion that affects plugins, provider trust, startup, doctor, and update behavior; automation can find defects, but it cannot choose the long-term slot ownership contract for maintainers.

options.title: Accept after repair and proof
options.body: Sponsor the object-form owner record direction, but require the remaining raw-reader/docs fixes, rebase, and exact-head behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Defer behind slot architecture
options.body: Keep this PR open or pause it until the broader memory slot architecture establishes the final slot shape and ownership fields.

options.title: Stay string-only for now
options.body: Close or ask for a narrower PR that only refactors existing string readers without accepting object-form persisted config yet.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Sponsor the object-form owner record direction, but require the remaining raw-reader/docs fixes, rebase, and exact-head behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on plugin install slot selection and activation makes this the strongest observed routing owner for the config/slot decision.
